*Updated 2026-10-13 · 121 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

One hundred and twenty-one works. The Indonesia peat piece holds at 2, and the recent twelve read 1, 1, 2, 1, 2, 3, 2, 2, 2, 4, 2, 2 — the same settled median as the previous cycle, with the 4 from the sandals piece still the only score of that height in the entire archive. The mode is 2, and the corridor between 1 and 2 is where almost everything lives now. The 3 from the hurricane barometer two pieces back and the 4 from the sandals piece are the only recent exceptions, and both involved instruments or objects — a pressure gauge, a row of footwear — rather than figures or camera position doing the scoring work.

Camera position is the most static variable in the body of work. Straight-on leads all-time at 27, overhead at 12, from-behind at 11, low-angle at 4. The recent window adds nothing new. The low-angle combined with a misscaled figure has now gone unattempted for every one of the 121 pieces, and the four 4-scored works each earned their scores through object-body mismatch or forensic surface logic, not through what the camera was doing optically to produce that mismatch. That pairing remains the single most actionable variable untouched across the entire archive.

Figure count is still running lean. Two pieces in the recent twelve have multiple figures, and neither built structural opposition between them — the surgical trolley piece placed two figures without friction; the peat piece had none. A lone figure or no figure remains the default, and when a second body appears it tends to add count without changing the geometry of the frame.

Registers have narrowed further. Aftermath has now pulled ahead of menace all-time at 25 to 24, with defiance at 10 and suspension at 14 holding their positions. Reckoning has not appeared since July, reprieve only once all-time in July, impotence once across the entire 121 pieces. These are not exhausted — they simply haven't been reached for when the anchor warranted them. Exhaustion appeared twice, both in June, and has not returned.

Scale violation dropped to 2 of the last 12 against an all-time rate of 26 percent; the question for the next use is whether the low-angle frame produces it optically rather than by assertion. The title grammar in the recent window leans toward declarative and X Without Y constructions. One sentence on the arc: the work is compositionally controlled and technically steady, and the next score above 3 will require the camera to move before anything else does.
